data.strategy: One shared clean plate, selective old-neutral-metal removal, RGB exposure fits to existing v4 pixels; no per-frame image generation or human deformation.

data.geometryInvariant: One fixed world vertex buffer and cross section; fixed pivots; per-frame yaw only; constant cap projection.
data.modelDescription: Curved beveled rectangular silver tube and annular collar. No humanoid mesh, human rendering or human warping.

axisSourceProvenance.note: Each full source frame is byte-identical to the archived pre-structureV4 input. Fits inspect only unoccluded rubber shaft rows158..173.

data.materialSampling: Single transverse RGB profile sampled from canonical generated silver, continuous across broad flat faces. Fixed-world softbox with narrow bevel highlights and reduced specular.
data.geometry: Single fixed beveled rectangular curved tube; per-frame yaw only, fixed weak-perspective instances. Annular collars use constant10degree local view.
data.camera: Fixed orthographic on booms; fixed10degree view on collars about their own centers.
data.profileSamplingMethod: Monotone cubic in height. Radial extent reachesR150 byheight91 and remainsconstantthroughlowerverticalend.
data.includes: Silver moving booms, rigid annular collars and short sampled-rubber connectors. No human pixels or fixed pivot drums.
limitations: CollarY149 is fixed while independently generated source collars vary by a few pixels.
Far instance uses a fixed weak-perspective scale109/118.
Material reuses generated silver pixels with deterministic lighting; it is not a calibrated multi-view BRDF.
Compose over the upper clean plate before evaluating removal of the old silver arms.

rubberGeometry.type: one fixed radius8 height14 cylinder mesh, perframe rigidZ rotation only, fixedweakperspectiveinstance scale
rubberGeometry.protectedBoundary: Geometry extends below164 during supersampling; final alpha is zeroed only after downsampling so row163 stays fully connected.

axisFits.method: Actual shaft centerline fit per frame, extrapolated to149/164. No skin or hand warping.

temporalRegularization.method: Least squares actual targets with weak second-difference penaltylambda0.5, blended back when needed to cap every endpoint drift at0.8px. Silver mesh/pivot stays fixed.

sourceProvenance.note: Each full source frame is byte-identical to the archived pre-structureV4 input. Fits inspect only unoccluded rubber shaft rows158..173.

data.rubberMaterialSampling: One stable transverse RGB profile from the generated canonical rubber shaft; fixed cylinder and rigid Z rotation only.
